scene: demo1, 200 wait commands after timedemo starts; 640×480; fixed host_framerate 0.05

pairs.title: Visibility: more submitted geometry need not change the view
pairs.description: PVS rejection is disabled. Walls still occlude geometry through depth testing, so a similar image does not imply equal rendering work.

pairs.title: World geometry and entities
pairs.description: The enemy, pickup and weapon disappear. The bars also disappear: moving brush models are entities. The static BSP world and particles remain.

pairs.title: The lightmap pass
pairs.description: The multipass path draws its lightmap texture without the usual blend. This diagnostic is not a final illumination-only render; entities keep their textures. Both captures use -nomtex and gl_texsort 1.

pairs.title: Renderer counters in the console notification area
pairs.description: The top-left console notifications show milliseconds, world polygons (wpoly), and entity polygons (epoly). Several recent frames remain visible; the displayed timing is one instrumented run.

notes: Captured from clean native macOS commit 7a74a7c, not documentation baseline 3ef8a7a. Host and GL render paths cited here are unchanged between those commits.
Unedited engine screenshots, converted from TGA to PNG with sips. No overlays were drawn onto the images.

Separate scripted runs use the same demo-message index, fixed 0.05-second simulation step, and camera. The baseline pause command does not freeze demo playback; timedemo plus wait supplies reproducible frame selection instead.
All shots use -nomtex, gl_texsort 1, viewsize 100, and muted audio. r_lightmap has no effect in the default multitexture path.
Each variant has a companion .cfg. Reproduce from the repository with python3 docs/architecture/life-of-a-frame/capture.py. This creates a temporary clean export and builds the pinned revision.
